text:
I would consider 45 business days as the acceptable maximum. There were almost no holidays during this period, so I believe you crossed that line already. Generally, in many branches, if there is no issue that needs a review by the manager, they tend to give the visa on the spot. Such a long waiting period in a - by their own admission - uncomplicated case should not be considered normal. I would go to the office and ask politely but persistently for an update. Both a good first impression and the impression that you are not a pushover are important for a smooth sailing in Misrad Hapnim waters.
EDIT: Just checked. Today is technically the 42nd business day. So on Sunday, you should have reached the reasonable max limit.
